description_expanded: Welcome to Emerald Flamingo, a stunning home in Panama City Beach! Minutes from 30A, this centrally located retreat is just steps from the beach and features a private pool, pergola, and plenty of privacy! Whip up delicious meals in the sun-lit kitchen while family and friends relax in the spacious living room with a sofa, loveseat, and flat-screen TV. You’ll find plenty of places to enjoy morning coffee, whether at the breakfast bar, dining table or under the shaded pergola. After days spent in the private pool, refresh in bright and cheerful bathrooms and unwind in cozy bedrooms! Located in the heart of Panama City Beach, Emerald Flamingo is located within minutes of popular restaurants, including Sunnyside Grill, Back Beach Barbecue, Coconuts, Bayou Bill’s Crab House, and Lake Powell Pizza. Nearby family-friendly attractions include Pier Park, Shipwreck Island Water Park, Camp Helen State Park, Lake Powell, and Zoo World. With the communities of 30A just minutes away, every day is full of adventure! Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise. Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
